minor.issue: A syntactically invalid base58 signature (e.g., '1'*88) makes Solana RPC raise 'Invalid param: WrongSize'; services/live._fetch_tx does not catch RuntimeError from services/market.rpc, so the request 500s instead of the intended 409 'not confirmed yet' or 422 'malformed signature'. Wrap _fetch_tx in try/except RuntimeError → return None (treat as unconfirmed), or validate base58 length in the pydantic model.

action_items: Optional: harden POST /api/live/confirm against malformed base58 signatures (catch RuntimeError from Solana RPC 'WrongSize' → 409 or 422 instead of 500).
critical_code_review_comments: services/live.py::_fetch_tx swallows only the absence of a tx (returns None) but re-raises RPC RuntimeError, leaking a 500 to Director UX for any malformed signature. Add a try/except around await market.get_transaction(...) that treats RuntimeError as 'not yet confirmed'.
routers/live.py::ConfirmRequest validates length only (64–100). Add a base58 charset regex to fail-fast on obvious garbage before burning a Solana RPC call.

services/live.build recomputes wallet_snapshot after invalidate — good — but does not guard against Jupiter route regression between /quote (used in UI) and /build (server-side re-quotes). Minor: worth logging the quote diff to detect adverse re-quotes at execution time.

rca of the issue: Confirm-500 root cause: services/market.rpc raises RuntimeError on any {jsonrpc:{error}} payload. Solana rejects a signature whose base58 decodes to != 64 bytes with 'Invalid param: WrongSize'. services/live._fetch_tx only handles the null-result branch; the raised RuntimeError propagates through FastAPI as 500. Fix: wrap the get_transaction call in try/except RuntimeError inside _fetch_tx and return None (so confirm surfaces the intended 409 'not confirmed yet — wait and retry'), or add base58 validation on ConfirmRequest.signature (e.g., regex ^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]+$ plus a decoded-length check for exactly 64 bytes).
